title: Blue Harbor Retail: second damaged replacement
transcript:
Agent: Blue Harbor support, this is Noah. How can I help?
Customer: Hi Noah, this is Dana from Blue Harbor Retail. The replacement for order BH-7734 arrived, and two of the units are damaged again. The frames are bent in the same place.
Agent: I am sorry. Let me pull up ticket T-3001 and the order history. I see the original damage on June 15, the replacement shipped on June 17, and the photos you sent. This looks like the same packaging problem.
Customer: Yes, the boxes are crushed on the same side. We cannot keep accepting replacements if they arrive like this.
Agent: I understand. I am going to approve a second replacement and escalate the packaging issue to our quality team. I will also ask the warehouse to inspect the units before they ship.
Customer: Do we need to send photos again?
Agent: Yes, please send photos of the new damage and the boxes. I will attach them to the ticket and to the quality escalation.
Customer: Okay. How long will the second replacement take?
Agent: The warehouse should ship within two business days. I will schedule a follow-up for July 8. If the second replacement is also damaged, we will need to look at a different resolution with your account manager.
Customer: Fine. Please make sure quality sees the history. This is the second time.
Agent: They will. The escalation references both shipments and your photos. I will email the ticket update today.
